title: The Borrowed Orchard
author: Xanthe Okonkwo
blurb: Oscar Delacroix, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
